description: Supplements and health items whose seller states a claim: HSA/FSA eligibility or a certification mark (USP, NSF, Informed Sport, GMP, ConsumerLab). Claims are seller-stated and not verified by Coreplex; shoppers should confirm with their plan or the certifier. Prices and stock come from the live Shopify catalog at the time of the call. Checkout happens on the seller's own Shopify store; Coreplex adds no fees.
